gates.description: TODO: add description — audit-batch-deliverables.mjs JSDoc block is empty.
Generates a bundle composition report at docs/perf/bundle-report.html using vite-bundle-visualizer. Manual channel only — artifact, not gating.

Merged gate (13z-6): (1) --tokens: token compliance audit for HDS components (hardcoded hex/rgba/opacity/radius/spacing/transition values); (2) --completeness: asserts every shipped component has a rich manifest entry for LLM use; (3) --docs: documentation coverage gate (every component shown by at least one Storybook story under src/stories — re-pointed there after ADR-018 cut the bespoke docs site this gate had been reading); (4) --api: public API surface guard comparing against docs/api/api-baseline.json. Default: runs all 4. Merged from: audit-components + check-component-completeness + check-component-docs + check-public-api.

Dependency vulnerability audit wrapping pnpm audit --audit-level moderate. Translates each advisory into a registry violation; critical/high are errors, moderate/low are warnings. Manual channel only (network required).
TODO: add description — audit-exceptions.mjs has no leading JSDoc block.

Static purity audit. Scans every registered gate's source for fs writes, Date.now / Math.random, network imports, and process.env access outside an allowlist. Produces docs/guardrails/purity-audit.md. Warn-only by default; --strict exits 1 on any IMPURE-without-exception gate.

Meta-gate ratchet for the --json rollout (per unit 13p-8). For each registered gate outside pnpm-meta, spawns `node <gateScript> --json` with a 30s timeout and verifies stdout parses as { violations: Array }. Reports compliance counters; emits Violation rows for non-compliant gates so they surface in the strict-gate inventory. Severity:warn initially; flip to error once 100% comply.
Generates a CycloneDX Software Bill of Materials at docs/security/sbom.json. Manual channel — produces an artifact, not a gate. Useful for the GRC narrative and supply-chain review.
Audits CSS token bridges and visual overrides against the JSON token source of truth.
Keeps the attribution registry machine-checkable. Checks that registry IDs in ATTRIBUTIONS.md are present and unique, and that asset manifest sourceId values resolve to known registry IDs.
Soft gate that catches the failure mode where a component starts referencing a component-tier CSS variable that the masters pipeline doesn't know to bind.
Validates that all living documentation files are in sync with the current brand values in hirobius.tokens.json. Exits non-zero if stale values found.

CI-safe Figma Code Connect gate (no token, no network, any Figma plan). Runs figma connect parse --exit-on-unreadable-files, fails if the committed src/app/components/*.figma.ts templates drift from scripts/generate-code-connect.mjs output, requires every public cva module to have a template or an exemption in figma/code-connect.json, and renders every VARIANT x BOOLEAN combination locally (getEnum maps are exhaustive and land on cva keys, snippets are valid JSX that only pass real props). Templates without a Figma node URL are reported as unmapped (--strict fails on them). Also runs in pnpm test through scripts/__tests__/check-code-connect.test.mjs.

WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio checker for HDS semantic color pairs. Reads hirobius.tokens.json, resolves primitive + semantic color aliases, and reports contrast ratios for critical text/bg pairings in both light and dark mode. Also gates a non-text tier (§1.4.11, 3:1) for border tokens that bound an interactive control's only affordance (#230).
Verifies that hand-authored bridge vars in theme.css stay in sync with the token source of truth in hirobius.tokens.json.

Every theme-sensitive `--x: var(--y)` alias must also be declared in the [data-theme="dark"] block. Declared only in :root, such an alias is substituted there and inherits its LIGHT value when a theme is scoped to a subtree rather than to <html>. Reads the EMITTED CSS, because every token gate resolves the graph in JS where the indirection is correct by construction.
Deprecation-lifecycle gate: every @deprecated JSDoc in the component tier must carry a future @removeIn <semver>; fails when a deprecation goes past-due (removeIn <= current package version).
Catches raw numeric width/height style values in app component/page files before they reach the broader audit lane. This is the narrow, fast gate for the most common component sizing mistakes.
Keeps escape hatches visible and well-formed. Checks that only known exemption markers are used and every exemption marker includes a non-empty reason after the colon.

Counts coverage from the FIGMA side: every component set published to the library (figma/inventory.json) must be reachable from code through an @figma JSDoc tag. figma:links --check counts the other direction — components in code that carry a tag — so a design published in Figma and never wired up is invisible to it. Refuses to report green from an inventory marked complete:false, because a hand walk cannot prove a page is absent. firingChannel is manual until a full `pnpm figma:inventory --fetch` inventory is committed; it becomes ci-pr then. Exit 0 clean, 1 unmapped assets or an incomplete inventory, 2 no inventory yet.

Compares the Figma model built from hirobius.tokens.json against the committed Figma snapshot (figma/snapshot.json) and reports missing, extra and changed variables, modes, default modes and styles. Exit 0 clean, 1 drift or an edited snapshot, 2 no snapshot yet. In ci.yml with --ci: fails only when Figma was last pushed from exactly the model the tokens build now (snapshot lastPush.modelHash) and still differs; drift that may be an unpushed change warns, no snapshot is a notice.

Enforces the component parity contract (docs/architecture/variant-contract.md#figma-mapping): manifest variantAxes, componentProperties and figmaPropertyMapping must bind to props the component really accepts (TypeScript checker), contract axes backed by cva must be declared with matching enum values, inverted booleans must be "Show …" toggles, and Code Connect templates must map the same contract axes. Title Case property names are advisory warnings.
A11y focus state checker for HDS components and pages. Every interactive element must have a visible focus indicator.
Catches raw pixel comparisons against known breakpoint values in JS/TS. All JS/TS viewport comparisons must use hds.breakpoints.* — no raw px numbers that match a known breakpoint value.
Catches hardcoded color values in non-CSS color contexts that bypass the CSS custom property cascade and are invisible to check-inline-styles / check-tier-bypass.
gates.note: Demoted off pre-commit in #52 (commit-time friction). #181 re-introduces automatic gating via ralph/gate.sh — a different, lower-friction PR-time channel, not a re-reversal of #52. See #188.

gates.description: Scans all TSX/TS component files for raw pixel values in style props that should use hds.space.*, hds.density.*, or var(--hds-space-*) instead.

Flags raw px/number layout values (margin*, padding*, position, top/right/bottom/left/inset, gap/rowGap/columnGap, flexBasis) inside inline style={{…}} in src/app/components. Points violators at Box sx (the sanctioned escape hatch) or a named layout primitive (Stack/Grid/Container) instead of check-hardcoded-spacing's generic token-var fix. Introduced with #98 (layout-consistency epic #95, workstream 4).
License compliance gate. Runs pnpm licenses list --prod and blocks copyleft/restrictive licenses (GPL/AGPL/LGPL/SSPL/BUSL/EUPL/OSL/CC-BY-NC/CDDL).

Unified link integrity gate: (1) active docs do not point at missing local files, (2) external href URLs return non-4xx, (3) internal route targets are known app routes. Merged from check-doc-references, check-external-links, check-route-links (13z-6).
TODO: add description — check-manifest-drift.mjs has no leading JSDoc block.
Compares the current manifest/schema.json against manifest/schema.lock.json and flags breaking changes (property removals, type tightenings) as semver violations.
Verifies that interactive components ship with motion feedback — the HDS standard that every user action has a visible, token-timed response.

Escape-hatch policy: the non-interactive feedback primitives (Badge, Alert, Callout) are className-only and expose no `style` prop (no explicit style member; HTMLAttributes extensions must Omit 'style').

Enforces HDS prop-value vocabulary on component primitives: feedback tone/variant unions use danger (never error); size unions stay on the sm|md|lg ramp (no default/compact); tone is drawn from neutral|danger|success|warning|info; density is drawn from comfortable|compact. --coverage prints the cva-adoption rollout tracker (informational, always exit 0).

Every props type annotating a component the public barrel exports must itself be exported, so a consumer can name it. Reachability, not the `Props` suffix: cva VariantProps aliases, composition bases, union arms, cast targets and private sub-components' props stay internal.

Renders every Storybook story in Chromium and reports layout defects no textual gate can see: content overflowing its frame, boxes clipping their own text, elements pushed past the viewport, controls with no rendered box or below the WCAG 2.2 AA 24px target, a decorative indicator (ring/dot/track/thumb) collapsed to 0px, links whose only affordance is colour, misaligned table-row baselines, a control boundary below the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 non-text floor, and text below the WCAG 1.4.3 AA floor -- all measured against the actually-painted, composited color, not a declared token pair. Every context freezes CSS animations/transitions before a story's first paint, so a story whose geometry is a function of animation time gets one repeatable measurement (#282). Existing debt is accepted explicitly in docs/guardrails/rendered-geometry-baseline.json so new findings fail while known ones do not. Closes the blind spot #245 exposed, where 55 structurally broken dark-mode aliases passed every token gate, and the blind spot #234/#240 exposed, where a 1.26:1 control border and a 1.00:1 segmented-control label passed every textual gate. Needs a real browser + a built Storybook, so it is out of scope for the static fixture-dir harness (docs/guardrails/FIXTURE_DIR_HARNESS.md's needs-runtime exception, same as check-code-connect/check-route-smoke).

hds#206 -- flags raw integer literals on sx spacing shorthand props (p/m/gap/px/py/mx/my/pt/pr/pb/pl/mt/mr/mb/ml/rowGap/columnGap), the exact px-ambiguous numeric-scale form Adrian's 2026-09-26 decision bans in favor of semantic.space.scale.{xs,sm,md,lg,xl}. Warn severity: reports the debt, does not yet block -- promotion to error, wiring into an automatic channel, and the consumer codemod are hds#206 remaining work.

Joins the four records that describe a component -- source file, manifest entry, Storybook story, Figma node -- into one table with a per-component verdict, so an editing target can be looked up instead of remembered. Re-derives story ids from source rather than trusting the manifest, so a stale manifest fails rather than passing a gate whose job is to prove the records agree. Fails on a drop in story or Figma coverage, on a story file that resolves to no component, and on manifest drift. Expectations come from the ratified disposition (hds#235): a layout primitive is never reported as missing a Figma node it is not supposed to have. Also writes docs/sync-map.json (--write) -- committed generated output the agent-facing README describes as 'the same data for agents'. --check (hds#277) recomputes it and diffs byte-for-byte against what's on disk, failing and naming every disagreeing component if the committed file has drifted from its source records (hand-edited or stale). Pre-commit runs the plain gate (coverage/orphan checks) and `--check` (docs/sync-map.json drift) back to back.

Re-derives asserted integers in root status.json that already have a derivable source (e.g. stories carrying a Storybook play() field) and compares them against a generated witness at docs/guardrails/status-claims.json, so a hand-typed number cannot silently go stale the way status.json's '56 stories have play() functions' claim did (hds#285) -- that count came from a naive `grep play:` matching `display:` in inline styles; the true count was 0. `--write` regenerates the witness after a claim is corrected; `--check` fails on drift.

ADR-010 retired the auto-generated docs/SYSTEMS-LOG.md ledger and named the replacement: git history + CHANGELOG.md + ADRs, plus status.json for the fleet dashboard. Nothing enforced staying current, so it held only when someone remembered (hds#249). Fails when a pushed commit touches src/, scripts/ or docs/adr/ and status.json updatedAt predates it, naming the offending commit and the fix. Separately fails when a pushed commit touches src/ with no pending .changeset/*.md and no "skip-changeset" marker in its own message, so a source change cannot ship with CHANGELOG.md left to go stale.

Fails when a consumer-facing component has no Storybook story. A storyless component is invisible on the generated reference site AND is never swept by check-rendered-geometry, so it reads as clean when nothing has looked at it. Exemption is not a list kept in the gate: it is the ratified disposition (hds#235), where internal components are out of the consumer-facing surface — seven of them are Compiler primitives defined in a build script rather than React modules. A hand-kept allowlist is what the old componentPreviewRegistry tried: 46 entries, 16 naming components that no longer existed, 109 of 139 missing.

Runs attw over the packed tarball so the PUBLISHED types are proven to resolve for a node16/nodenext ESM consumer. Nothing else sees that surface: tsc and every test read src/, and smoke:consumer proves subpaths import but not that their .d.ts resolve. The gap shipped 150 extensionless specifiers into a "type": "module" package, breaking types across 7 entry points with CI green. Profile esm-only (no CJS build here, node10 cannot read exports); the four CSS subpaths are excluded because stylesheets have no types to resolve.

Verifies that the HDS motion system respects prefers-reduced-motion: Layer 1 is CSS transitions (theme.css @media block); Layer 2 is motion/react components, which must read duration/easing via useHdsMotion() rather than the raw hds.motion.* token object (#190).
Verifies that HDS components rendering native form controls forward their ref to the underlying DOM element.
Validates that hds-registry.json is complete and up-to-date. Checks that there are no stub summaries and no page files are missing a registry entry.

Reads the built dist/ and checks 'use client' both ways: every chunk that imports React (directly or through an internal chunk) must start with it, and every framework-free chunk (brand, tokens, cn, manifest, mui) must not. Missing directives make a Next.js App Router consumer render hooks in a Server Component and fail on first import; spurious ones turn server-safe exports into opaque client references. Re-derives the rule from the files via scripts/lib/rsc-directive.mjs rather than trusting the build plugin ran.
Pre-commit secrets scanner wrapping the gitleaks binary. Registers gitleaks in the guardrail registry so it shows up in audits and fixture-proof runs.
Local security and dependency hygiene baseline. Checks that no committed runtime env files, npm credentials, obvious secrets, external font/CDN imports, or dangerous HTML injection exist in source.
Source-side companion to validators/swiss-canon.mjs. The JSX validator runs on LLM-generated output; this scanner runs on hand-authored .tsx files.

Merged gate (13z-6): (1) catches plain HTML elements with 6+ inline style properties; (2) catches suspicious style prop values (function/string references); (3) catches raw color literals in hand-authored CSS files. Sub-mode flags: --inline-only, --style-props-only, --css-values-only. Merged from: check-inline-styles + check-style-prop-values + check-css-values.

Asserts tailwind.config.tokens.cjs exposes spacing/screens/borderWidth/fontSize as theme.extend keys sourced from HDS tokens instead of Tailwind's built-in scale — spacing/borderWidth/fontSize as var(--…) refs, screens as resolved px literals, per ADR-024.
Prevents direct edits to auto-generated output files by checking that if an output file has been modified, the corresponding generator script is also modified.
Validates every tenants/<slug>/tokens.json against HDS structural rules. Runs as a standalone CLI tool and as a pre-commit gate.
Enforces the primitive -> semantic -> component aliasing hierarchy in source files. Direct use of var(--primitive-*) in component and page files bypasses the semantic tier.

Merged gate (13z-6): default mode enforces token description quality in hirobius.tokens.json (missing/blank/verbose descriptions). With --quality flag: also scans generated-token-descriptions.ts for empty, generic-fallback, or one-sided-theme-language descriptions. Merged from: check-token-descriptions + check-token-description-quality.

Merged gate (13z-6): default mode scans src/** for unresolved design-token path references ({primitive,semantic,component,role}.x.y.z) against hirobius.tokens.json — fires pre-commit. With --ratchet flag: B-class monotonic-decrement ratchet asserting .token-path-baseline.txt entry count never increases — fires ci-pr. Use --update-baseline to record a new baseline. Merged from: check-token-paths (scan) + check-token-paths-ratchet (count ratchet).
Pre-commit guard: ensure generated token outputs are in sync with hirobius.tokens.json. A commit that edits the source but skips the rebake silently ships stale tokens.

Compares the current hirobius.tokens.json leaf paths against the committed baseline in tokens.lock.json. Any path present in the baseline but missing from current is a rename/deletion that needs a migration.
Validates hirobius.tokens.json for structural correctness. Catches cross-tier aliasing, theme coverage gaps, and non-monotonic ordered (t-shirt-size) scales.

Merged gate (13z-6): (1) prevents raw font family strings in fontFamily style props; (2) verifies @font-face url() paths in fonts.css resolve to real files; (3) enforces fontWeight/textTransform override discipline (single-weight + casing-via-eyebrow policy). Sub-mode flags: --fonts-only, --font-files-only, --overrides-only. Merged from: check-hardcoded-fonts + check-font-files + audit-typography-overrides.
Catches static multi-column gridTemplateColumns values with no nearby isMobile guard. Every multi-column grid must be responsive.
Meta-validator: every gate registered in docs/guardrails/registry.json has a firingChannel that matches actual invocation. Catches aspirational guardrails — gates registered but never really firing.

Meta-validator: walks registry.json and asserts every registered gate has a fixture pair (violating + passing). Stub fixtures warn; missing fixtures error; real fixtures run the gate and assert correct exit codes. mtime-scoped for fast pre-commit runs.
